title: Run and act record entry (DEL-04-03 OUT-001) — PROPOSED
description: PROPOSED record format of RS-v0.8 §13 (R12-1, R12-2; U-04). RS format 0.1 is the only record container (R14-1): a record is an append-only log of entries, one JSON object per line; every entry carries the common identity elements of RS §3 and one body by kind. The bodies of the checkpoint entry kinds (EXEC CE-1…CE-19) are DEL-02-03's and are referenced by relative path to EXEC's `checkpoint-record-entries.schema.json` (RS §13.3); the settings_version body is DEL-04-02's, referenced by $id. Names are Chirality's own; no host or supplier wire field is selected. No placement, path, identity algorithm or canonicalization is selected (OI-013, OI-014; DEL-03-01 TBD-003): 'method' names a designation only. Entries of kind destination_declined and boundary_refusal are PROPOSED recording (R12-10). The R11 labels include R13-1's and R13-2's.

evidenceRef.description: RS §9: a reference, never a copy. Resolution at read is the reader's and is not stored.

person.description: RS §6.1 decision actor. For App-captured acts: the name set in the App, the operating-system account and the Codex account when Codex reports one, marked identity not verified (DECISION-K1 K1-4).

runOpened.description: R1, R2, R4, R5a and the declared checkpoints listed as guidance (Phase 1). notStarted: R1 'run not started — no model selected' (R15-1), host-loop runs only.

derivedFrom.description: WD-v0.8 §6.1: the full identity tuple of the workflow adapted from, never a string (V18-2 m-9; RX). RS spells the tuple's elements in camelCase.

notStarted.description: R15-1 (DERIVED from V4-HOST-01; representation PROPOSED): a host-loop run that never reaches its first turn because no model is selected. No destination entry accompanies it (LOOP-v0.8 §3.1 F-2 (a); §5.2 MS-02).

enum: change items of a named proposal
objects changed by a named outcome

modelTurn.description: R5 per turn: requested and effective kept separate; an unobserved turn is unknown. A turn's effective value comes only from a supplier report that names that turn; a report that names only the thread is written with scope 'thread' and no turn (HOSTING U-27).

operationEntry.description: R7 (RS §5), core elements only in format 0.1; the full element list of RS §5 maps onto these and onto evidence references.

requestKind.description: ADAPTER §4.6 OM-2 request kinds and LOOP's; R14-3.

reason.description: The reason the outcome carries, e.g. a loop-side parse state (truncated · interrupted · malformed · filtered) or a schema reason (LOOP §7).

oneOf.description: The one wording (R12-10): 'prior act not counted', with its reason.

The labels 'waiting — re-held, lapsed after resume' and 'hold not enforceable' are governance-phase labels (RS R8): written only for a governed checkpoint in the governance phase, never in Phase 1 (RQ; V19-A n-6).

dispositionChange.description: CE-18 body (EXEC), with RS's structured annotations (R14-1).

humanAct.description: RS §6.1. Written only from capture evidence (HA-1). A15 is the registration of a workflow revision (R12-5).

allOf.description: A15: the bound content is the revision identity and the relations name the draft it derives from (R12-5).

carriedCall.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-1: the call the destination request carries (operation reference); required for scope once (ACT ND-A2). PROPOSED (node B5).

modelServiceClass.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-3 A-1 and R12-7 (N-OPEN-1): for a contact allowed by the model choice, the class the person's model choice states; never inferred from the address. PROPOSED (node B5).

destinationDeclined.description: PROPOSED recording (R12-10): V4-EXM-23 says a decline is reported to the agent; no accepted text says it is recorded.

reportedToAgent.const: destination not allowed by the person

stage.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-4: where the native layer refused. PROPOSED (node B5).

statelessEvidence.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-7 (SE-1…SE-3) for an MCP server; its limit is the R11 label 'stateless revision declared, not verified'. PROPOSED (node B5).

suppliedGuidance.description: R3: per thread and turn, the source identity and content identity of each guidance input supplied; supplied is not adopted.

examinationFindings.description: R10: A3 findings by reference; never 'host checks passed', never A4.

toolPermissionSettlement.description: R13 (A14; App runs only): the settlement and its origin. Never a human-act record, never a grant.

compatibilityReportRef.description: R14: reference to a required-tool compatibility report evaluated for the run.

destinationRequestClosed.description: LOOP-v0.8 §5.3 DF-6: how a destination request ended other than by a grant in force or a decline. PROPOSED element (node B5); for 'not granted' after the person's grant the refused A12 is its own human_act entry.

workflowTuple.description: WD-v0.8 §6.1 identity tuple in RS's spelling (`workflow-declaration.schema.json#/$defs/workflow_identity`: source_root → sourceRoot, derived_from → derivedFrom, revision_method → revisionMethod). A derived-from tuple names the workflow adapted from (RX).
